audience: General engineering comparison/report; no journal-specific compliance claimed
cpu: Existing unmodified O3 scalar INT8 reference, one Cortex-A9 CPU1, no NEON; existing baseline disables auto-vectorization
scope: 33 operators; PL includes PS register programming and polling; both exclude model loading, input preprocessing/copy and output extraction
environment: Same Linux, CPU1, performance governor; engine, panel, manager and capture stopped, display driver unloaded, no PL reconfiguration
estimator: Median for each input/path; aggregate median of the three input medians; speedup=matched ARM median / PL median
uncertainty: Descriptive observed min/max and raw repetitions, not population confidence intervals
noExclusions: No measured runs or inputs removed based on latency; warmups predefined and separate
restoration: Reload framebuffer driver; restore inittab/governor, model/product and processes; verify fresh preview and file hashes
softwareReference: Kassis, T., Agarwal, V., He, Y., Patel, D., & Brueckner, A. M. (2026). Scientific Agent Skills: A Library of Procedural Knowledge for Research Agents. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2609.00065; arXiv current record checked 2026-10-26 (v2).
